title: Post Name
salary: Selected candidates will be placed in Pay Level-07, Level-10, or Level-11 of the Pay Matrix as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (7th CPC), depending on the post. Several posts also carry Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) in addition to the basic pay.
age_limit: The upper age limit varies by post and category, ranging from 33 to 43 years as on the closing date for submission of the online application (the crucial date for determining age limit). Age relaxation of up to 10 years is available for PwBD candidates for posts identified as suitable or reserved for them.
selection_process: Selection to these posts is made through Recruitment Test (RT), wherever applicable, followed by an Interview, or by Interview alone. The minimum level of suitability in the interview is 50 marks for UR, 45 marks for OBC, and 40 marks for SC/ST/PwBD candidates out of 100 total marks. Candidates must meet the minimum suitability criteria at both the RT and Interview stages, wherever an RT is conducted. || Also Read: UPSC Recruitment for Assistant Soil Chemist, Prosecutor, Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor & 10 Other Posts – Apply Online

title: Vacancy No.
qualification: Note: Qualifications and experience are relaxable at the discretion of UPSC for reasons recorded in writing, particularly for otherwise well-qualified candidates and for SC/ST candidates where sufficient experienced candidates are not available.
age_limit: Age is further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD candidates, subject to a maximum age limit of 56 years. Additional relaxations apply for Ex-Servicemen (5 years) and Central/UT Government employees (up to 5 years), as detailed in the Concessions & Relaxations section of the notification.
application_fee: Fee can be paid via Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card, UPI, or Internet Banking. Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or selection.
selection_process: Selection will be made through a Combined Recruitment Test (CRT) to shortlist candidates for interview, followed by a Personality Test/Interview . Key details: || CRT will be held on01 November 2026at 15 designated centres. || The test is of 2 hours' duration, objective type (MCQs), available in English and Hindi, carrying a maximum of 300 marks. || There is negative marking: one-third of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer. || Weightage of CRT and Interview marks is75:25for determining final merit. || Minimum suitability standard in interview: General/EWS – 50 marks, OBC – 45 marks, SC/ST/PwBD – 40 marks (out of 100).
